proposedBellaRules.scope: Supported legacy OMF1/Bento1, fresh reader requirements only. Identity/ownership and text rules already agreed. No runtime implementation, cutover, Bin Filter change, final source priority or new header-opening reason.
proposedBellaRules.owner: Use the associated master selected by agreed full-ID/role/source-link rules before reading its name; keep that master for its other fields. A missing/empty name does not select another master.
proposedBellaRules.field: Read the exact legacy OMFI:CPNT:Name with omfi:String type. OMF2 MOBJ:Name is a deferred schema mapping, not a Unicode backup. No separate UTF-8 component-name counterpart was established; marked Unicode attributes do not invent one.
proposedBellaRules.text: Apply the already agreed Mac-focused MacRoman legacy rule with checked bounded reading. Preserve spelling, punctuation, case and whitespace. Stop at the first NUL or declared value end; a complete bounded string need not store a terminator. No UTF-8 validity guessing, trimming or Unicode normalization.
proposedBellaRules.unavailable: No uniquely qualified master, missing/empty/unusable name or contradictory required Name values gives no OMF Clip Name. Equal repeated values may describe one name. Keep physical row, valid IDs and independent technical facts.
proposedBellaRules.display: Keep physical Filename separate. No replacement from Filename, file mob, track or onward original-source names. Blank for an OMF-only fallback without a usable name; final cross-source priorities remain later.
proposedBellaRules.retention: Owned selected QString and necessary availability only; release raw name and temporary owner/index storage with OMF job. Small C++17/Qt6.5.3 helper, no per-field class or permanent alternate-name graph.

Otherwise it allocates or resizes a handle to recordedLength+1, requests exactly recordedLength bytes, checks returned byte count and appends its own NUL. It does not validate a recorded terminator in this bounded helper. These facts should not be turned into an additional Bella string-framing policy without the separately agreed text rules.
